feeds.title: Palestine Chronicle
feeds.description: The Palestine Chronicle is a non-profit organization whose mission is to educate the general public by providing a forum that strives to highlight issues of relevance to human rights, national struggles, freedom, and democracy in the form of daily news, commentary, features, book reviews, photos, art, and more.

feeds.title: Palestine TV
feeds.description: Local news on politics, economics, culture, sports, health, technology, and more.

feeds.title: The Palestinian Information Center
feeds.description: The Palestinian Information Center is a media website specialized in the Palestinian issue in its human, human, political, and cultural dimensions. The website was founded in 1997, and it was the first to cover Palestinian news.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Palestinian Authority
feeds.description: The latest news and daily updates from Palestinian.

feeds.title: Watan News
feeds.description: An independent news site that seeks to present democratic national media and is part of a media system.

feeds.title: WAFA News
feeds.description: WAFA seeks to produce and disseminate news and information on Palestine worldwide as well as to provide readers with insight into events from a Palestinian perspective. WAFA strives to influence public opinion at the local and international levels, with a focus on the religious, geographic, and historical importance of Palestine.
